# Design

How this app is built: its stack, layout and conventions.
Read it with `AGENTS.md`, which has the working rules and how the app is tested.

*TanStack's own documentation is vendored in this repo under `docs/tanstack/`: the official
`llms.txt` index for TanStack Router (`router.llms.txt`) and TanStack Query (`query.llms.txt`).
Consult it when working with TanStack Router or Query.*

---

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints — routes MUST live under `rest/api/`

Put every domain REST route under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/` so its path starts
with `/api/`: `SpaConfig` only lets `/api/*` reach the backend, and a non-`/api/` route is swallowed
by the SPA deep-link fallback (it returns `index.html`, not your endpoint). The reference below uses
non-`/api/` example paths for brevity — in this app the `/api/` prefix is required. See
`src/main/resources/officefloor/README.md`.

---

*The following is OfficeFloor's own agent guidance for this stack, included verbatim
from <https://officefloor.net/AGENTS.md>. It is part of the OfficeFloor architecture.*

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints

Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.

- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.

package net.officefloor.hq.app.period;

import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.time.YearMonth;
import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.sheet.Sheet;
import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Out;
import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestBody;

/**
 * One period per calendar month from the from-date's month to the to-date's month, each from the month's first to its
 * last day and named yyyy-mm; a month whose name is already a period on the sheet (ignoring case), or whose days
 * overlap one, is left out. A blank date is the sheet's today; a to-date before the from-date is refused.
 */
public class BuildGeneratedPeriods {
    public void build(@RequestBody @Valid GeneratePeriodsRequest request, @Val Sheet sheet, PeriodRepository repository,
            Out<GeneratedPeriods> generated) throws InvalidPeriodException {
        LocalDate from = date(request.from(), "from-date", sheet.today());
        LocalDate to = date(request.to(), "to-date", sheet.today());
        if (to.isBefore(from)) {
            throw new InvalidPeriodException("The to-date must not be before the from-date.");
        }
        List<Period> existing = repository.findAll(sheet.id());
        List<Period> made = new ArrayList<>();
        for (YearMonth month = YearMonth.from(from); !month.isAfter(YearMonth.from(to)); month = month.plusMonths(1)) {
            Period period = new Period(sheet.id(), month.toString(), month.atDay(1), month.atEndOfMonth());
            boolean free = existing.stream()
                    .noneMatch((other) -> other.name().equalsIgnoreCase(period.name()) || other.overlaps(period));
            if (free) {
                made.add(period);
            }
        }
        generated.set(new GeneratedPeriods(List.copyOf(made)));
    }

    private static LocalDate date(String value, String label, LocalDate today) throws InvalidPeriodException {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            return today;
        }
        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(text);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
            throw new InvalidPeriodException("The " + label + " must be yyyy-mm-dd.");
        }
    }
}
package net.officefloor.hq.app.period;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;

public class SaveGeneratedPeriods {
    public void save(@Val GeneratedPeriods generated, PeriodRepository repository) {
        generated.periods().forEach(repository::insert);
    }
}
package net.officefloor.hq.app.period;

import net.officefloor.hq.app.Audit;
import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;

/** Records each generated period as added, earliest first, in the form a period added by hand takes. */
public class AuditGeneratedPeriods {
    public void audit(@Val GeneratedPeriods generated, @RequestParam("user") String user, Audit audit) {
        for (Period period : generated.periods()) {
            audit.record("PERIOD_ADDED sheet=" + period.sheetId() + " by=" + user + " period=" + period.name()
                    + " from=" + period.from() + " to=" + period.to());
        }
    }
}
package net.officefloor.hq.app.period;

import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;
import net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse;

public class RespondWithGeneratedPeriods {
    public void respond(@Val GeneratedPeriods generated, ObjectResponse<GeneratePeriodsResult> response) {
        response.send(new GeneratePeriodsResult(generated.periods().size()));
    }
}

}

/**
 * One period per calendar month from the from-date's month to the to-date's month, each from the month's first to its
 * last day and named yyyy-mm; a month whose name is already a period on the sheet (ignoring case), or whose days
 * overlap one, is left out. A blank date is the sheet's today; a to-date before the from-date is refused.
 */
public class BuildGeneratedPeriods {
    public void build(@RequestBody @Valid GeneratePeriodsRequest request, @Val Sheet sheet, PeriodRepository repository,
            Out<GeneratedPeriods> generated) throws InvalidPeriodException {
        LocalDate from = date(request.from(), "from-date", sheet.today());
        LocalDate to = date(request.to(), "to-date", sheet.today());
        if (to.isBefore(from)) {
            throw new InvalidPeriodException("The to-date must not be before the from-date.");
        }
        List<Period> existing = repository.findAll(sheet.id());
        List<Period> made = new ArrayList<>();
        for (YearMonth month = YearMonth.from(from); !month.isAfter(YearMonth.from(to)); month = month.plusMonths(1)) {
            Period period = new Period(sheet.id(), month.toString(), month.atDay(1), month.atEndOfMonth());
            boolean free = existing.stream()
                    .noneMatch((other) -> other.name().equalsIgnoreCase(period.name()) || other.overlaps(period));
            if (free) {
                made.add(period);
            }
        }
        generated.set(new GeneratedPeriods(List.copyOf(made)));
    }

    private static LocalDate date(String value, String label, LocalDate today) throws InvalidPeriodException {
        String text = value == null ? "" : value.trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) {
            return today;
        }
        try {
            return LocalDate.parse(text);
        } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
            throw new InvalidPeriodException("The " + label + " must be yyyy-mm-dd.");
        }
    }
}
